Taylor (AE): Heads-up — Neptune Labs dropped a full CAIQ plus a short PCI appendix with two BYOK/HSM Qs. POC demo Tue 10am PST, they want the questionnaire answered before demo. Who can triage?
Amanda R: I can take first pass today. Will map against our canonical CAIQ answers and highlight gaps. @Raj P will need to review security flags.
Raj P: Thanks. Can you paste the doc link here? Need to confirm it's full CAIQ and see custom Q wording.
Taylor (AE): Link: https://neptune.example.com/secure/caix-2026 (password in LastPass). It's the full CAIQ + PCI appendix lines 3/4 about HSM certs and BYOK lifecycle.
Amanda R: Plan: 1) reuse existing CAIQ answers where possible, 2) mark bespoke PCI Qs with owner and rationale, 3) draft ETA and blockers. I'll create a diff doc and set status tags.
Security Bot: Created SEC intake ticket SEC-4392 and linked it to this thread.
Raj P: For HSM/BYOK we need engineering confirmation — what we actually support in Dedicated vs Private, and any constraints for Hosted. @Linh T can you confirm?
Linh T: Quick note: Private (VPC) supports customer-managed KMS keys via customer KMS; Dedicated needs a service ticket for BYOK and has provider-dependent HSM cert requirements. Hosted (shared) cannot support BYOK.
Linh T: I'll write a short explainer for the doc: ```BYOK flow: 1) Customer provides KMS metadata/ARNs 2) We validate IAM permissions and access patterns 3) We configure key access controls and rotate as mutually agreed 4) HSM certs are procured per infra provider and may add latency to delivery.```
Amanda R: ETA initial triage by EOD today. I'll include a one-line status summary at the top: "reuse / clarify / security-needed" for each question.
Taylor (AE): Client asked about turnaround — can we say 48-72h post-triage? They're pushing product team to confirm before the demo.
Raj P: 48-72h is reasonable if triage is done today and no external HSM cert procurement is required. If we need vendor certs or SOC documentation from infra partner, add 1-2 weeks.
Amanda R: Uploaded mapping: https://drive.redwood/incoming/neptune-caix-diff.md — top section has a red/amber/green table, comments inline.
Raj P: Reviewing now. I'll add suggested contract addendum language for BYOK/HSM if we decide to accept.
Taylor (AE): Procurement also wants to know whether an SOW or security addendum is needed. Please call out in the doc.
Amanda R: Marked contract implications per question. Security items tagged "security-required"; legal/contract flagged separately.
Security Bot: Noted no active incidents. Added dependency: infra-team confirmation.
Linh T: Adding quick note for the Dev/Platform team to validate: expected API for KMS ARNs and least-privilege IAM snippet. Will paste sample snippet into doc.
Amanda R: Final: owners set in the doc: Security = @Raj P, Platform Eng = @Linh T, AE = @Taylor (AE). I'll ping at 5pm with final triage status. :thumbsup:
Taylor (AE): Excellent — I'll tell the customer: triage today, answers in ~48-72h unless HSM vendor docs needed.
